name: machete-chop
note: CU-107: the machete. The hand chambers back, rises for the chop, comes down in front of him, and follows through low across the body. t is 0..1 of the machete swing (0.40 s). Offsets in his own axes (x out to the knife side, y up, z forward), metres. Kept inside an arm's reach of the chest point so the IK can get there.

places.rest: where the pose has the hand this frame (the swing starts and ends there)
places.chest: a point in front of his upper chest (torso space 0, 1.22 m, 0.12 m)
